name: Dumbbell biceps curl
notes: Standing curl. Record the load of one dumbbell.

guide.setup: Stand tall holding dumbbells at the sides with palms forward and elbows close to the ribs.
guide.execution: Curl toward the shoulders while keeping the upper arms still, then lower slowly to full elbow extension.
guide.cues: Keep ribs down. Move at the elbow. Control the lowering phase.
guide.mistakes: Swinging the hips; elbows drifting forward; shortening the bottom range; bending the wrists back.
